people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: When the Philistine looked around, and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and had a good looking face.
translations.bsb: When the Philistine looked and saw David, he despised him because he was just a boy, ruddy and handsome.
translations.kjv: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
translations.asv: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him; for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and withal of a fair countenance.
